raw_record.question_text:
Read the seawater isotherm map and complete the following questions.

<image1>

The dashed lines in the figure indicate ocean currents. Which ocean current is a warm current and is located in the Southern Hemisphere?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中有两个小图，①的等温线标值自上而下为18℃、20℃、22℃，②的等温线标值自上而下为22℃、20℃、18℃，虚线表示洋流。再推理：②中上方较暖、下方较冷，说明其位于南半球；结合虚线洋流的流向，若它由暖水区流向冷水区，则为暖流。②符合“南半球且暖流”，答案为②。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中有左右两个海水等温线小图，虚线表示洋流。左图标为①，右侧等温线数值自上而下依次为18℃、20℃、22℃；右图标为②，右侧等温线数值自上而下依次为22℃、20℃、18℃。右图②中虚线洋流大致由上方向下方流动。
再推理：按常规图上方为北、下方为南。②图中上方水温高、下方水温低，说明越向南水温越低，符合南半球的温度分布。暖流是由较暖海域流向较冷海域的洋流；②中洋流从上方较暖水域流向下方较冷水域，因此是暖流，且位于南半球。所以答案为②。

再推理：按常规图上方为北、下方为南。②图中上方水温高、下方水温低，说明越向南水温越低，符合南半球的温度分布。暖流是由较暖海域流向较冷海域的洋流；②中洋流从上方较暖水域流向下方较冷水域，因此是暖流，且位于南半球。所以答案为②。

再推理：按常规图上方为北、下方为南。②图中上方水温高、下方水温低，说明越向南水温越低，符合南半球的温度分布。暖流是由较暖海域流向较冷海域的洋流；②中洋流从上方较暖水域流向下方较冷水域，因此是暖流，且位于南半球。所以答案为②。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This route classifies the current mainly from the current direction relative to the temperature gradient, then uses the same temperature labels to determine hemisphere. It is distinct from an isotherm-bending/anomaly method because it depends on reading the dashed current’s transport direction.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the two boxed isotherm diagrams labeled ① and ②. In ① the right-side temperature labels are 18℃, 20℃, 22℃ from top to bottom; in ② they are 22℃, 20℃, 18℃ from top to bottom. Also read the dashed line as the ocean-current line and use its indicated direction in the panel.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question’s requirement: find the dashed-line current that is both a warm current and located in the Southern Hemisphere.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Sea surface temperature generally decreases from low latitude to high latitude. If temperatures are warmer at the top and colder at the bottom, the panel represents the Southern Hemisphere because moving downward is poleward. A warm current transports warmer low-latitude water toward colder high-latitude waters.

The left figure is labeled ①, and the isotherm values on the right side from top to bottom are 18℃, 20℃, and 22℃ in order; the right figure is labeled ②, and the isotherm values on the right side from top to bottom are 22℃, 20℃, and 18℃ in order. In the right figure ②, the dashed-line ocean current generally flows from above to below.
Then reason: According to the convention, the top of the figure is north and the bottom is south. In figure ②, the water temperature is high above and low below, indicating that the farther south, the lower the water temperature, which conforms to the temperature distribution of the Southern Hemisphere. A warm current is an ocean current that flows from a warmer sea area to a colder sea area; in ②, the ocean current flows from the warmer water area above to the colder water area below, so it is a warm current and is located in the Southern Hemisphere. Therefore the answer is ②.
